cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: AI-powered financial ledger for African small businesses, parsing Mobile Money SMS and WhatsApp debt agreements offline.

test_prompts.prompt: Parse this OPay SMS: 'You have received N50,000.00 from CHINEDU OKAFOR. Ref: 20260817001. Bal: N125,450.00.' Log it as income.
Abeg remind Chinedu say him still owe me 45k from the last delivery. He said he'll pay after market day. Extract the customer, amount, type, context, and due date.
